second_meeting.note: Conditional on each December outcome; members' latest words carried forward; no new data or market moves assumed; February is an MPR meeting.

rationale_as_policy.note: vote rationales counted as policy-focused speeches; a separate weight (learned from the boxes alone, published since Nov 2025) was not significantly better

selection.method: core structure kept as a bundle if significantly better than 'repeat your last vote'; each later add-on kept only if it significantly lowers log loss. Nested leave-one-year-out (the recency half-life chosen on training years only); meeting-level paired bootstrap, 2000 draws, 95% interval.
